name: StackPrimaryButton
description: Primary rounded CTA from the Stack mobile team-lunch flow, used for add-to-order, place-order, and other high-confidence actions.
accessibility: Use for real button actions only, not navigation links.
Keep the visible label specific to the action.
If leading or trailing content is icon-only, ensure it is decorative or separately named.

do: Use one primary CTA in a sticky bottom action area.
Use tone="ink" for secondary dark floating CTAs such as view group order.
Use trailing for prices in checkout-style actions.
dont: Do not use for low-priority filter chips.
Do not put multiple full-width primary buttons in the same mobile viewport.
Do not override colors outside the Stack token palettes.
